summary: Antonelli's presence at Ferrari ignites Monza with competing narratives—will the Italian rookie's home-circuit heroics capture the tifosi's hearts, or does the Scuderia's championship fight with Mercedes demand all attention? Mercedes maintains its straight-line advantage despite Ferrari's engine upgrade, forcing the Italian team to hunt gains through high-speed corners and tactical pit strategy at a circuit that rewards pure speed. A decisive result here reshapes the championship complexion, as either Mercedes extends its lead or Ferrari capitalizes on home-track momentum to claw back ground before the season's final stretch.
